signatures.description: Implement a Raft membership transition and snapshot restore path that remains safe when a node crashes between joint-consensus commitment, snapshot installation, and log truncation. The implementation must reject stale leaders, preserve quorum intersection across restart, and provide deterministic tests that explore message reordering and duplicate delivery without assuming synchronized clocks.
